candidates.comment: An editor relation between a creative work and the person who edited it. Also called "edited by", "compiled by", "prepared by". Examples: "Book 'The Great Gatsby' editor 'Maxwell Perkins'", "Journal article editor 'Dr. Jane Doe'", "Film 'Pulp Fiction' editor 'Sally Menke'".

candidates.label: operatingSystem
candidates.comment: An operating system supported by a software application. Also called supported OS, compatible operating system, runs on. Examples: "Software X operatingSystem 'Windows 10'", "App Y operatingSystem 'iOS 16'", "Game Z operatingSystem 'macOS Ventura'".
